text:
From the final sleep in which he lay,
the solicitous lover was mocked
by Anaxarete, watching snow steal
its last cold rose.


She, always rebellious, dismissed
not hardness but her fierce soul,
and gave hatred an alabaster fortress,
for she loathed her flesh for being soft.


You can be no harder now, Lisi,
and though some punishment awaits you,
it will be to take form in my tender love.


You will be more immortal in my pure faith,
for I pledge myself to your hardness,
than in hateful marble, though it be eternal.

translation.title: From the Last Sleep in Which I Lay
